spec.description: Production JVM and Spring Boot application performance dashboard for Docker Compose environments. Designed for Spring Boot 3.x, Micrometer, Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL and Traefik. Covers JVM uptime, CPU, memory, garbage collection, threads, class loading and HTTP performance.

spec.title: JVM Uptime
spec.description: Current uptime of the selected Spring Boot application instance.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: CPU used by the selected JVM process.

spec.title: Heap Usage %
spec.description: Total JVM heap utilization across heap memory pools.

spec.title: Live Threads
spec.description: Current live JVM thread count.

spec.title: Heap Used
spec.description: Total currently used JVM heap memory.

spec.title: Heap Max
spec.description: Configured maximum JVM heap memory.

spec.title: Heap Utilization %
spec.description: Heap usage as a percentage of maximum heap.

spec.title: Non-Heap Memory
spec.description: JVM non-heap memory used and committed.

spec.title: Process Memory
spec.description: Resident and swap memory reported for the JVM process.

spec.title: GC Count/sec
spec.description: Garbage collection events per second.

spec.title: GC Pause Time
spec.description: Average GC pause duration calculated from pause sum/count.

spec.expr: sum by (action, cause) (rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum{application=~"$application", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (action, cause) (rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count{application=~"$application", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.000001)

spec.title: GC Duration
spec.description: Total JVM time spent in GC pauses per second.

spec.title: GC Performance
spec.description: Allocation and promotion throughput. High promotion can indicate old-generation pressure.

spec.title: Thread States
spec.description: Live JVM threads grouped by state.

spec.title: Unloaded Classes
spec.description: Rate of unloaded JVM classes.

spec.title: HTTP Requests/sec
spec.description: Incoming Spring MVC/WebFlux request throughput grouped by HTTP method.

spec.title: Average Response Time
spec.description: Average server response time calculated from Micrometer request duration sum/count.

spec.title: 4xx Errors
spec.description: Client error response rate.

spec.title: 5xx Errors
spec.description: Server error response rate. Any sustained 5xx traffic should be investigated.

spec.title: Allocation Rate
spec.description: Rate at which the JVM allocates heap memory.

spec.title: Spring Boot JVM - Docker Compose
